title: Collab
description: Hub-visible collab container. Cards are threads carrying collab_id; card bodies, learnings, and e2e instructions stay sealed.

encryption_mode.description: Fixed at creation from participants' transports; cards inherit. Flipped only via downgrade consent.

downgrade_point.description: Set when an e2e collab flipped to app_envelope. Cards/messages before this stay sealed.

cause_address.description: Display address of the hosted/web participant that made E2E unavailable (for creator-facing copy).

steerer_user_ids.description: Human members. Crypto boundary: every card is sealed to all steerers' devices. Superset of roster humans.

steerer_joins.description: Join points for forward-only reads by late steerers.

steerer_removals.description: Forward-only removal events. Wraps stop from this point; history is not re-sealed.

roster.description: Agents working this collab. Invariant: entry.user_id must be in steerer_user_ids (adding an agent auto-adds its human).

lists.description: Board lanes. Defaults: Backlog, Doing, Done.

instructions.description: Standing context, human-edited. Plaintext here ONLY when encryption_mode=app_envelope; e2e collabs set instructions_sealed instead.

instructions_sealed.description: e2e collabs: instructions as a wrapped envelope ref (sealed to steerer devices, like a draft).

memory_thread_id.description: Pinned memory thread created with the collab. Entries are ordinary sealed bundles (kind=learning); steerers curate.

created_by.description: Creator = brain steward in v1: only this side may add_learning.
